messages:
anya: Heads-up: just saw a spike of Provisioning timeouts in ap-southeast-2 starting ~5m after the egress hardening rollout.
devon: same, lots of `403` from keystore and KMS proxy during node bootstrap.
anya: node agent log snippet: `2026-03-23T10:12:02Z ERROR keystore: request failed 403 Forbidden https://keystore.internal/v1/session` — warmpool joins stalled.
security-bot: Change applied: egress-tighten/v5 to vpc-prod-llm (by security-pipeline). Summary: default deny, allowlist -> managed-prefix PL-INFRA-GLOBAL + 52.120.0.0/14.
luke.sre: PL-INFRA-GLOBAL apparently was updated earlier today; looks like the new prefix-list omitted our keystore subnet 10.49.22.0/24.
devon: consequence: allocator cannot fetch tokens -> containers stuck in ContainerCreating -> autoscaler trims GPU size -> latency spikes.
ops-bot: Impact: warm-pool -40% in ap-southeast-2, failed launches 18%, provisioning latency +7m.
anya: quick remediation options: 1) append keystore/KMS CIDRs to the allowlist 2) rollback egress change 3) open per-subnet exception. Prefer minimal blast: append missing CIDRs with a canary.
devon: +1. Also request immediate small rollout to only ap-southeast-2a first.
luke.sre: opening CR now with rollback SHA and preflight check added to the change note.
security-bot: CR#4420 opened by luke.sre: append 10.49.22.0/24 and 10.49.23.0/24 to PL-INFRA-GLOBAL for vpc-prod-llm. Canary target: ap-southeast-2a. Rollback: restore previous prefix-list contents.
security-bot: Prefix-list update applied: PL-INFRA-GLOBAL now includes 10.49.22.0/24,10.49.23.0/24. change-id pl-4420.
anya: can someone curl the keystore from a stuck node?
luke.sre: from a broken node `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://keystore.internal/v1/ping` -> 200
devon: warm-pool rebuild in progress, 3 nodes Ready within 90s. provisioning errors decreasing.
anya: root cause: egress preflight didn't validate managed prefix-list contents vs our infra service registry. We have a drift between prefix-list id and expected CIDRs.
luke.sre: actions: ENG-PLT-5001 create an "egress service registry" and add a pipeline preflight that verifies prefix-list membership for critical services (keystore, kms, allocator). assign devon.
ops-bot: Ticket ENG-PLT-5001 created; owner devon.
anya: finance: please estimate cost delta for fallback to CPU and NAT retries between 10:12-10:30 UTC. rough hit likely in low hundreds.
luke.sre: adding postmortem note to the change and closing once ENG-PLT-5001 starts. thanks for the quick patch everyone. :thumbsup:
